baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus consists of the ordered letter-names alif, lam, and mim, with no rooted morphemes or predication.
baseline_models.mechanism: A serial vocal and graphic event is available, but lexical assertion is withheld; the opening makes form and recitation precede proposition.

changed_reading.before: An opaque abbreviation awaiting expansion into a hidden statement.
changed_reading.after: A deliberately nonlexical threshold whose immediately available action is to be seen and voiced in sequence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Three alphabetic units occur in a fixed order without binding into a rooted word.
baseline_models.mechanism: Sequence is already present while lexical synthesis is withheld, foregrounding components before a composed discourse.

changed_reading.after: An ordered set of linguistic components displayed prior to lexical composition.

context_deltas.mechanism: Because alif-lam-mim can be voiced without making a lexical claim, the immediate movement from spoken belief to assay, disclosure, and realized truth turns its semantic suspension into a gap between utterance and verification.

activation_trace.role: Externalized speech supplies the claim whose mere voicing is insufficient.
Heart-settling assent supplies the asserted content that must become more than sound.
Assaying metal or a person supplies the discriminating process applied to the claim.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the eventual uncovering of what speech alone leaves unresolved.
Truth realized in promise and action supplies the verified outcome beyond verbal profession.

structural_cues: 29:2-3 moves from saying belief, through trial, to the disclosure of truthful and lying parties.
The focus precedes that sequence while itself offering pronounceable form but no proposition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies utterance, trust, assay, disclosure, and truth realized in action; I infer that the focus's withheld proposition formally stages the interval between saying and verification. A live alternative is that the letters are only an incipit with no thematic role.

changed_reading.before: The opening suspends lexical meaning without specifying why.
changed_reading.after: The opening enacts a claim-free threshold before the surah tests whether voiced belief becomes disclosed truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The first-position display of discrete alphabetic material is activated by the paired motions of beginning, forming, returning, and bringing forth again: articulated discourse unfolds from units and recitation repeatedly returns those units to voiced form.

activation_trace.role: Opening and putting first make the focus's initial position function as a beginning rather than an isolated anomaly.
Origination and bringing into existence supply the transition from available units to formed discourse.
Return after departure and repetition after beginning supply the recurrent re-voicing of the opening.
Causing a thing to emerge supplies a second formation from the initial display of components.

structural_cues: 29:19 pairs beginning creation with returning it.
29:20 repeats the command to inspect how creation began and then names another emergence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies beginning, origination, return, and renewed emergence; I map that cycle onto textual composition and re-recitation. The compositional arrow is mine, and the live alternative is a purely formal alphabetic opening unrelated to creation.

changed_reading.before: The letters are ordered components without synthesis.
changed_reading.after: The letters become a compositional zero point: discourse begins from exposed units, and every recitation brings that beginning forth again.

context_deltas.mechanism: The letter-names are simultaneously visible marks and sounds that follow one another. The later recitation-book cluster activates them as a minimal specimen of revelation crossing ordered inscription, serial voicing, and inward custody.

activation_trace.role: Sound following sound makes the ordered voicing of separate letter-names an instance of recitational sequence.
The ordering of letters into what is written supplies the compositional medium from which the focus deliberately stops short.
Ordered written letters make the focus inspectable as script even before lexical decoding.
A manifest sign allows visible form itself to carry evidentiary force without becoming an ordinary word.
The bodily chest supplies inward lodging for signs that also exist as voiced and written forms.
One sound following another makes the written book present as an event repeatedly heard.

structural_cues: 29:48 contrasts prior recitation and book with tracing by the right hand; the packet supplies no branch inventory for خ ط ط, so this remains structural.
29:49 places clear signs in chests, while 29:51 describes the book as recited to its hearers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies serial sound, ordered letters, visible signs, inward chests, and the explicit recitation-writing contrast; I infer that the focus condenses these media into one event. A live alternative is that its graphic and oral forms are incidental to the later book discourse.

changed_reading.before: A nonlexical threshold that can only be repeated.
changed_reading.after: A minimal specimen of the book's double life: ordered marks become sounds one after another and are carried inward without requiring lexical expansion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The reduced, nonpropositional opening is re-read as a deliberately retained trace: absence of a lexical body need not mean absence of signification when a remaining mark can disclose by its very visibility.

activation_trace.role: An effect remaining after departure supplies the focus with the form of a preserved textual residue.
A visible sign makes the residual form positive evidence rather than merely missing explanation.
Meaning disclosed through speech or a mark supplies the trace with a communicative function.

structural_cues: 29:35 explicitly combines leaving, sign, and clarity in one construction.
The focus is itself a conspicuous remainder-sized form: present and ordered, yet lacking ordinary predication.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a remaining effect, a visible sign, and disclosure by mark; I infer that the focus's reduction is residue rather than deficiency. The live alternative is that 29:35 concerns only its narrated material sign and does not reflect back on the opening.

changed_reading.before: Lack of lexical content feels like missing information.
changed_reading.after: The reduced opening can function as a retained sign whose fragmentary form is itself what asks to be recognized.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the packet explicitly marks the focus rootless and alif is not identical to the hamza radical. It remains worth carrying because the ordered graphic frame alif-lam-mim closely matches the contextual root sequence hamza-lam-mim through initial alif as hamza seat. Downstream prose should call this a retrospective consonantal echo of pain, never a lexical parsing, translation, or intended decoding of the opening.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The three focus letter-names occur in the same order as the visible consonantal frame associated with ء ل م, subject to the alif-hamza distinction.

activation_trace.role: The branch's painful descriptor supplies an attested contextual realization near the opening's ordered letter-frame and activates a contained pain resonance.

changed_reading.before: The letter sequence has no available root resonance inside the focus.
changed_reading.after: Once the painful descriptor appears, the opening can carry an exploratory echo of ء ل م while remaining grammatically and lexically rootless.

strongest_changes: The immediate trial sequence turns semantic suspension into a formal gap between voiced profession and verified truth.
The recitation-book cluster turns the opening into a compact crossing of visible letters, serial sound, and inwardly held signs.
Beginning, creation, return, and renewed emergence activate the initial letters as a compositional zero point.
summary.what_was_special: Because the focus has no rooted morphemes, context could not refine a lexical baseline; it instead activated sequence, position, medium, residue, and one explicitly contained consonantal echo.
remaining_uncertainties: The trial, creation, and retained-sign models depend on formal analogy rather than a grammatical link supplied by the focus.
The alif-hamza distance prevents the pain-root echo from establishing a lexical reading.
The writing-recitation model is strongly packet-supported but may describe how the opening is encountered rather than what it denotes.
